# Careers in Film

> > Comprehensive career guides and resources for breaking into film and television production across all departments and roles.

Careers in Film provides detailed job descriptions, salary information, and career pathways for aspiring filmmakers, crew members, and actors. The site covers everything from above-the-line creative positions to below-the-line technical roles, with practical guides on filmmaking fundamentals, education options, and portfolio development.

## Key Topics

- Film careers and job descriptions
- Cinematography and camera department
- Directing and production
- Screenwriting and script development
- Acting career development
- Casting process and roles
- Art department and production design
- Sound and music production
- Stunts and choreography
- Film education (USC, UCLA, AFI, Chapman, NYU)
- Below-the-line crew positions
- Demo reels and acting resumes
- Filmmaking fundamentals for beginners
- Drone and aerial cinematography

## Career Guides by Department

- [What Does a Film/TV Director Do (And How Do You Become One?)](https://www.careersinfilm.com/film-director): Director career guide featuring insights from Hisham Abed and Mark Tonderai
- [How to Become a Cinematographer | Description & Salary](https://www.careersinfilm.com/cinematographer): Cinematographer/DP career guide with salary info and industry insights
- [Production Designer: Job Description & Career Guide](https://www.careersinfilm.com/production-designer): Production Designer career guide managing art dept and visual design
- [Art Director: Career Path, Salary & How to Become One](https://www.careersinfilm.com/art-director): Art Director career guide covering set design and production collaboration
- [How to Become a Casting Assistant | Description & Salary](https://www.careersinfilm.com/casting-assistant): Casting Assistant career guide covering job duties, salary, and career path
- [How to Become a Drone Pilot in a Film/TV Camera Department](https://www.careersinfilm.com/drone-pilot): Career guide for drone pilots capturing aerial footage in film/TV production
- [How to Become an Armorer/Weapons Master on Film Sets](https://www.careersinfilm.com/armorer): Armorer career guide covering weapons safety and handling on film sets

## Filmmaking Fundamentals

- [How to Make a Short Film in Six Simple Steps](https://www.careersinfilm.com/how-to-make-a-short-film): Six-step filmmaking guide from pre-production to editing for beginners
- [What Does A Filmmaker Do? Everything You Need to Know](https://www.careersinfilm.com/what-does-a-filmmaker-do): Overview of filmmaker roles, specialties, and success traits in film
- [Below the Line Positions That Can Make or Break a Film](https://www.careersinfilm.com/below-the-line-film): Below-the-line crew roles including line producer and cinematographer

## Screenwriting & Script Development

- [Screenplay Writing: From Story Idea to First Draft](https://www.careersinfilm.com/screenplay-writing): Screenwriting process guide covering beat sheets, software, and treatments
- [How to Write a Movie Script: The Basics of Storytelling](https://www.careersinfilm.com/how-to-write-a-movie-script): Movie script writing basics covering three-act structure and formatting
- [The Shooting Script: What It Is and How to Make One](https://www.careersinfilm.com/shooting-script): Shooting script guide for directors and cinematographers in production

## Acting Career Resources

- [How To Make An Acting Resume (With a Template)](https://www.careersinfilm.com/acting-resume): Acting resume guide with template and examples for casting submissions
- [Demo Reels for Actors: Why You Need a Reel & How to Make One](https://www.careersinfilm.com/demo-reel): Actor demo reel guide for creating casting portfolios and getting work

## Film Education & Schools

- [The Top 13 American Film Schools](https://www.careersinfilm.com/top-film-schools): Rankings of top US film schools including USC, UCLA, Chapman, and NYU
- [8 Online Film Schools You Should Know](https://www.careersinfilm.com/online-film-schools): Online film programs at Full Sail, LA Film School, NYFA, and more

## Department Overviews

- [Careers in Film/TV Pre-Production Art](https://www.careersinfilm.com/pre-production-art): Overview of pre-production art careers including storyboarding and graphics
- [Film Sound & Music Careers](https://www.careersinfilm.com/sound-music): Overview of sound/music careers: composers, Foley artists, boom operators
- [Stunts & Choreography Careers in Film/TV](https://www.careersinfilm.com/stunts-choreo): Overview of stunt coordinator and choreographer careers in film/TV
